headline: Eagles WR Devonta Smith To Miss Multiple Games
summary: Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith is expected to be sidelined for multiple games with a “lingering right hamstring injury that initially caused him to miss time during camp,” per Olivia Reiner of The Philadelphia Inquirer. headline: Packers OLB Micah Parsons Might Not Play Until November
summary: Currently on the reserve/PUP list, Packers outside linebacker Micah Parsons will be eligible to play in Week 5. headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels Working To Return In Week 5; WR Terry McLaurin Could Miss Week 4
summary: With Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels still recovering from the dislocated left elbow he suffered in Week 2, backup Marcus Mariota will make his second straight start on Sunday. headline: Panthers place WR Xavier Legette on IR with knee injury
summary: The Carolina Panthers have placed 2024 first-round pick Xavier Legette on injured reserve ahead of Sunday's prime-time matchup against the Detroit Lions.
